signature.name: Song Mountain
signature.detail: A sacred Taoist mountain with dramatic peaks and historic temples, perfect for hiking and scenery. Wear comfortable shoes and bring water; the cable car saves time if you're short on energy.

signature.name: Henan Museum
signature.detail: One of China's best provincial museums, with treasures from ancient dynasties and a famous collection of bronze and jade. It's free with ID, closed on Mondays, and a good rainy-day option.

signature.name: Yellow River Scenic Area
signature.detail: See the mighty Yellow River up close, with viewpoints and a giant statue of the Yellow Emperor. It's a bit far from the city center, so allow half a day and check bus routes in advance.

food: Casual meal $5-10; street food even cheaper
